Dates.text: It lands in the Ocean of Storms, bouncing twice before settling.
Apollo 12 astronauts visit Surveyor 3 and bring parts of it back to Earth.

Title: Surveyor 3
Body-Text: Surveyor 3 was the third lander of its series, but the first to carry a surface sampler. Its scoop could reach 1.5 m from the lander and dig 18 cm into the lunar soil. Two years later, the Apollo 12 crew landed nearby and returned pieces of it to Earth.
